name: zvideo_dd3d_set_fog_start
description: zVideo_dd3d::SetFogStart updates cached Direct3D fog-start light state only when the requested start value changes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DD3D fog-state source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aaa30 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, stdcall float argument, x87 compare against g_zVideo_CachedFogStartLightStateValue, provider IDirect3DDevice2::SetLightState through vtable offset 0x64 with D3DLIGHTSTATE_FOGSTART and the raw fogStart float bits only when changed, and cache update after the provider call.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4aaa30 has no warning tags. There are no authored callees; SetLightState is a Direct3D provider boundary.
The native smoke uses the fake IDirect3DDevice2 provider to verify changed-value SetLightState dispatch, raw float-bit state value, cache update, and no provider call on a cache hit.
